title: Coral and the Contact
author: Ivo Winterbourne
blurb: Kestrel Halloran, a hostage negotiator with one failure still on the board, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the summit convenes.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
